subject.title: fix(onboarding): leave session.dmScope unset so the personal-agent default "main" applies

question: Should fresh local onboarding silently select the shared `main` DM session, or preserve isolating `per-channel-peer` behavior until a user explicitly chooses the personal-agent posture?
rationale: This is a deliberate first-run security and privacy posture change: code and docs can implement either path, but only maintainers can choose the acceptable default for newly onboarded installations.

options.title: Keep isolated onboarding default
options.body: Continue writing `per-channel-peer` for fresh local onboarding while documenting `main` as an explicit personal-agent choice.

options.title: Adopt shared personal-agent default
options.body: Merge the omission of `dmScope` only after confirming that first-run onboarding clearly communicates the shared-session consequence and exposes immediate isolation selection.

options.title: Add an onboarding choice
options.body: Ask users to choose personal-agent continuity or shared-inbox isolation and persist only the selected posture.

recommendation.title: Keep isolated onboarding default
recommendation.body: Continue writing `per-channel-peer` for fresh local onboarding while documenting `main` as an explicit personal-agent choice.

likelyOwner.reason: The PR explicitly presents this as an owner-level direction and steipete authored the proposed implementation and documentation.
